item.description: Outrage and intense protests erupted in New York after ICE agents opened fire on a 28-year-old man in a car with a 5-year-old child in the backseat. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

item.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

media:content.media:text: dog laying in a bed with light streaming in through the window
media:content.media:description: Humans off the bed? Trackers showed that people and dogs became active around the same time while they were sleeping, but it was the humans who moved first and disturbed their dogs, not the other way around.

item.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
